svg.aria-label: One continuously shuffled quote at a time from 31 anime, TV, and real-world quotes

g.text: “Talk is cheap. Show me the code.”
“Power resides where men believe it resides.”
“If you don't fight, you can't win.”
“Chaos isn't a pit. Chaos is a ladder.”
“The first principle is that you must not fool yourself.”

text.tspan: “When you're going to change the world, don't ask for
permission.”

g.text: “A mind needs books as a sword needs a whetstone.”
“This world is cruel, but it's also very beautiful.”
“In the pursuit of great, we failed to do good.”

text.tspan: “We're not free in what we do, because we're not free in
what we want.”
“If we have our own why in life, we shall get along with
almost any how.”

g.text: “There is no prize to perfection, only an end to pursuit.”

text.tspan: “When you're dead you're dead, and until then, there's
ice cream.”

g.text: “The beginning is the end, and the end is the beginning.”

text.tspan: “The man who passes the sentence should swing the
sword.”

g.text: “What I cannot create, I do not understand.”
“What makes you different makes you strong.”

text.tspan: “We can only see a short distance ahead, but we can see
plenty there that needs to be done.”

g.text: “The universe is change; life is opinion.”
“When do you think people die? When they are forgotten.”

text.tspan: “My soldiers, rage! My soldiers, scream! My soldiers,
fight!”
“Everyone had to be drunk on somethin' to keep pushing
on.”
“In the depths of winter, I finally learned that within me
there lay an invincible summer.”
